notes: Cosmetic pieces each crafting profession can sign. 'basis' says how solid the link is: 'crafted-variant' or 'signature-tag' means the catalog already marks the piece as a craftable variant or a signature item; 'proposed' means a static or stock-class piece with a clear craft fit that would need a new crafted variant. Carpentry (also instruments), tinkering (candelabras, lanterns, globes, goblets, clock) and blacksmithing (two suits of armor, a plate mannequin and bronze castings) have strong catalog support; tailoring, alchemy, cooking and inscription lean on 'proposed' pieces, and bowcraft has only two commons (the catalog has no rare fletching art). Owner decisions: whether a signed piece is a crafted copy of the base item or a reward for crafting milestones, and whether bowcraft needs new art. No NPC resale value, no stats.
